resolved.forward_model: rho_hat = alpha * mu；mu = max(cos_i, 0)；0 <= alpha <= 1；无截距、无漫射项

upstream_documents.gap_closed_by_subprotocol: 7.0 的最小评估单元写作 acquisition × non-overlapping ROI × band，而合同⑧写作 acquisition × band × fold。二者的对应关系由 core-topology 子协议 §5 显式声明为同一单元（fold ≡ non-overlapping ROI），故 pixel→acquisition×band×fold 的聚合规则唯一可解析。

aggregation_rules: 先在每个评估单元内计算指标
描述性汇总单元指标，不以像元池化替代单元级结果
acquisition 级汇总时各 acquisition 等权
当前样本量下只用中位数、范围与单元级表格
禁止像元级 p 值、置信区间、effective sample size 与显著性声称
同景折、共标定折与相邻 ROI 不得称为独立重复

resolved_for_clause_8.residual_semantics: specified-baseline model–observation residual，不是真值反演误差
resolved_for_clause_8.scored_mask_semantics: Only supported pixels contribute to supported-residual metrics

verdict.statement: core/topology 与 scoring protocol 经本 pre-flight 证明唯一可执行；两项均已闭合，7.3 可从 planned 转 active。
